verdict.rationale: Sumsub can be driven headlessly through its RESTful API, which processes applicant data and documents and gives full control over the verification flow. Webhooks deliver automated event notifications, a Sandbox mode supports testing integrations with app tokens, and an official MCP server lets AI agents perform Sumsub operations under role-based permissions. However, there is no evidence of a CLI or CI-specific guidance, and no machine-readable OpenAPI spec was found at any of the probed paths. missing for 10: official CLI, documented CI/pipeline usage, published OpenAPI spec, independent hands-on corroboration of headless automation.
